name: Per-label metrics with asymmetric errors
test:
e = Evaluator()
e.build_matrix(['cat','cat','dog','dog','dog'], ['cat','dog','cat','dog','bird'])
r = e.calculate_metrics()
assert [x.label for x in r] == ['bird','cat','dog']
assert [x.num_actual_samples for x in r] == [0,2,3]
assert e.matrix.get('dog','bird') == 1 and e.matrix.get('bird','dog') == 0
for got, expected in zip(r, [(0,0,0),(0.5,0.5,0.5),(0.5,1/3,0.4)]):
    assert abs(got.precision-expected[0]) < 1e-9
    assert abs(got.recall-expected[1]) < 1e-9
    assert abs(got.f1-expected[2]) < 1e-9

name: Rebuilding replaces prior counts, including empty inputs
test:
e=Evaluator()
e.build_matrix(['a','a'], ['a','b'])
e.build_matrix(['c'], ['c'])
assert e.calculate_metrics() == [LabelMetrics('c',1,1.0,1.0,1.0)]
e.build_matrix([], [])
assert e.calculate_metrics() == []
